name: classpilot
description: ClassPilot - AI workspace for students. V1: Chrome extension syncs Google Classroom into the ClassPilot backend.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @classpilot/shared build && pnpm --filter @classpilot/api build && pnpm --filter @classpilot/extension build && pnpm --filter @classpilot/web build
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @classpilot/shared build && concurrently -n shared,api,web,ext -c cyan,green,magenta,yellow "pnpm --filter @classpilot/shared dev" "pnpm --filter @classpilot/api dev" "pnpm --filter @classpilot/web dev" "pnpm --filter @classpilot/extension dev"
